_metadata.description: Expose the node identity/trust/reach/signaling seam so Device Control can provide desktop sessions without reimplementing fleet authority.

requirements.title: Device Control Desktop Integration Seam
requirements.deferred_reason: Bridge owns the interactive transport seam, while Device Control owns native desktop operation and Web Console owns the viewer. The production WebRTC consumer is outside the original Bridge foundation scope.
requirements.revisit_trigger: Device Control and Web Console begin the production WebRTC desktop session and require the Bridge-owned signaling/revocation seam.
requirements.description: Device Control opens real-time desktop sessions through Bridge's node identity, trust, signaling, revocation, and reach layer rather than reimplementing fleet authority. Device Control owns native capture, input, clipboard, leases, and receipts; Web Console owns the operator viewer. P2: the consumer integration is deferred from the Bridge foundation but must use the documented interactive channel contract and must not create a second remote-desktop authority.

validation.notes: Exposed (not built) consumer seam: Device Control consumes Bridge node identity/reach and the typed interactive channel. Document the protocol and revocation contract in the cross-scenario architecture record and Bridge SEAMS.md.
Device Control can resolve which nodes are trusted and open a bounded interactive session without receiving general job-execution or shell privileges.
